routines.semantics: Measure the angle at the target between illuminator and observer in radians. On reception the illuminating leg is evaluated at the target epoch appropriate to the target-to-observer light time. All three bodies must be distinct.
routines.edgeAssessment: Kernel-independent translation setup, exact zero and pi with distinct collinear bodies, mixed and moving sightlines, changing target, light time and stellar correction, initial/reloaded geometry.
routines.errorAssessment: IDCODENOTFOUND in each role, BODIESNOTDISTINCT for every pair, INVALIDOPTION for transmission/unknown corrections, EMPTYSTRING, NOLOADEDFILES, SPKINSUFFDATA at an emission endpoint. Failing translations use the checked original error path prior to the cache.

routines.semantics: Measure the solar longitude in radians relative to the instantaneous ascending equinox. Use the geometric heliocentric state and the body north pole to construct the frame, then use the corrected apparent solar direction.
routines.edgeAssessment: Epochs on both sides of J2000, pole changes, meridian invariance, alternate quadrants, reception and transmission corrections, unload and reload.
routines.errorAssessment: NOTRANSLATION, EMPTYSTRING, FRAMEDATANOTFOUND, NOLOADEDFILES, SPKINSUFFDATA, INVALIDOPTION and DEPENDENTVECTORS. Each failed stage is checked before its output is read. Scalar boundaries and PCK metadata guards are tested separately.

routines.semantics: Measure signed apparent center separation less the two angular radii in radians. POINT contributes zero. SPHERE uses the maximum of three positive radii. A negative result is overlap.
routines.edgeAssessment: Two targets swapped, point/sphere in both positions, triaxial permutations, mixed limb contact before and after tangency, arbitrary nonempty frame text, reception and transmission corrections, absent radii on two points.
routines.errorAssessment: Canonical EMPTYSTRING for either frame, NOTRECOGNIZED, INVALIDOPTION, BODIESNOTDISTINCT, IDCODENOTFOUND, NOLOADEDFILES, SPKINSUFFDATA, KERNELVARNOTFOUND, INVALIDCOUNT, BADAXISLENGTH and INSIDEBODY, including equality at the surface.
